load_work_audit.definition: Accepted-endpoint trapezoid of full soil RHS with interface loads removed, plus explicit structure loads; new nodes begin at each history own birth reference. Includes construction holding. Global F.d is separate.
load_work_audit.limitations: Derived observations from the fresh solved fields, not additional solves. Birth/removal quadrature is a discrete diagnostic, not exact continuous external work or a new energy acceptance criterion.

note: No general all-field/reaction-resultant/work/refinement tolerance was introduced. Unsupported combinations have no invented zero field differences. Earlier failures and historical NC unexecuted records are preserved.

work_refinement.note: Discrete endpoint cumulative work at the same 20 progress points; no continuous-path or new convergence certificate.
